facts.fact: An APAI-CRVS/UNECA presentation (July 2026) describes Ethiopia's national eCRVS as a phased rollout: pilot in Addis Ababa, scale-up to Amharic-speaking regions, then national expansion to non-Amharic regions.
The same presentation lists death registration and certificate, with health-facility death notification, among the services of the national eCRVS system, which it says improved CRVS operations.
